name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Adjust the thigh pad, grasp the bar overhand just outside shoulder width and sit with your thighs secured beneath the pad.
Sit tall with a slight natural lean back and start with your arms fully extended overhead.
Pull the bar smoothly down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows downward and squeezing your lats and shoulder blades together.
Control the bar slowly back overhead until your arms are fully extended and your lats feel stretched.
tips: Avoid leaning far backward or yanking the stack down with body momentum.
Keep your chest lifted and pull your elbows toward your sides rather than rolling your shoulders forward.
